components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      properties:

      required:

        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'

          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.

          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'

          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creation even if another owner has the same last name and address.

          writeOnly: true
          example: false

      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the last name and a global owner sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key joining the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the household id with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity key matches.

              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true

              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' from the customer code and the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true

              minimum: 0

              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3

x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'

- The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` field picks up `@PastOrPresent`, and the generated `OwnersApi.addOwner` already binds the body with `@Valid @RequestBody`. Notably I avoided touching the large, high-complexity `addOwner` controller method, which would have been the expensive place to add a manual check.
- It's the idiomatic Spring path: declarative Bean Validation on the request DTO rather than imperative date-comparison logic, and it reuses the app's existing validation-to-400 error handling.

Omitted (absent `registrationDate`) still defaults to the server date as before, since `@PastOrPresent` permits null.
